requirements.expected: Exactly four named artifacts with matching preview/.nx artboards and stable source hashes.

implementation.detail: The contract extractor enumerates the same four required artifacts; hashes and dimensions are recorded above.

requirements.expected: Abyss and Glacier board values, signal voices, family hues, line opacities, and semantic state roles match the CSS tokens.

implementation.detail: Palette.rs contains the exact hex roles for both appearances and the five family hues.

requirements.expected: Archivo/Instrument Sans/Newsreader/Geist Mono with exact size, line-height, weight, stretch, and tracking metrics.

implementation.detail: Font families and embedded byte hashes match. TypeScale uses a different ladder: Section=20px/24px vs reference title=20px/26px, Title=30px/32px vs reference display=30px/36px, Body=14px/24px vs reference body=13.5px/21px, and Micro=10px/14px vs reference micro=10.5px/14px.

requirements.gap: Reconcile TypeScale names and line metrics before accepting native pixel parity, especially at increased interface sizes.

requirements.expected: 46px titlebar, 54px rail, 38px rail buttons, 32px inputs, 30px omnibar, 30/24/38/46px button ladder.

implementation.detail: Current header is hardcoded 64px, shelf is hardcoded 248px, content padding is 40px, and status bar is 28px. Chrome::TITLEBAR=44px exists but is not used by render_root/header.

requirements.gap: Use canonical Chrome tokens and the Facet titlebar/rail composition; native pixels are unobserved until the build lane is available.

requirements.expected: Width-aware panel transformations; compact rail at narrow widths, context rail/full on wider widths, no clipped content.

implementation.detail: ResponsiveLayout::resolve is implemented but render_root never calls it; current render tree always appends one fixed shelf and one padded body. Settings flags shelf_open/context_open are stored but not projected into view geometry.

requirements.gap: Wire width class and panel modes through render_root and test at 640/800/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 widths, plus 80%-150% interface size.

requirements.expected: 14px chamfer polygon, weave/high-low edge treatment, state encoded by bevel, and periwinkle focus halo.

implementation.detail: surface::cut only draws a rectangular GPUI Div with two 18px accent hairlines; it does not clip/chamfer or apply weave/bevel gradients. surface::raised uses a generic shadow_lg.

requirements.gap: Implement cut plates as GPUI layout primitives with clip geometry/edge children, keeping canvas out of the path; validate crop corners at 1x and 2x.

requirements.expected: One mark establishes stone, stripes, chevron, bevel, comb, and cut-corner jobs across the product.

implementation.detail: Current shell renders text 'Nudox' and embedded facet/facets SVG assets but has no mark lockup or composable stone/stripe/chevron/comb primitives in the views.

requirements.gap: Compose the shell identity from GPUI primitives and the existing semantic family/kind system; current SVG path is a declared user constraint risk.

requirements.expected: Hue identifies family; shape identifies kind; family rows and icon atlas remain legible at large text and narrow widths.

implementation.detail: Palette and closed kind asset map exist, and product routes use kind marks. The full family/kind atlas, comb/mosaic examples, and dense family semantics are not present in the shell views.

requirements.gap: Audit every route card/row for family hue plus kind shape, then stress the mapping with 150% interface size and a 640px viewport.

requirements.expected: Mint acts, periwinkle focuses, amber waits, coral stops; edge/bevel communicates Rest/Focus/Yours/Working/Waiting/Stopped/Not yet.

implementation.detail: ControlState has eight explicit values and maps colors/motion, but current product controls remain generic CE buttons and rectangular panels. The seven edge-coded state plates are not composed in route views.

requirements.gap: Expose state edge treatments consistently on cards, loading, stale, offline, error, selected, and disabled surfaces.

requirements.expected: 90/160/240/380/620ms tokens, matching easings, and 1ms reduced-motion collapse.

implementation.detail: Motion enum values and reduced-motion snap behavior match the token durations. The harness has deterministic virtual time and frame sampling.

requirements.expected: Hover/press/route/overlay motion explains state and remains retargetable; full motion changes pixels and reduced motion settles.

implementation.detail: UiRootEntity advances a timeline, but no view property reads a track or emits route/overlay transforms; most product surfaces are static Div trees. Native transition pixels were not available.

requirements.gap: Bind route descent, panel collapse, overlay rise, hover lift, and working indicators to motion tokens and prove both full/reduced captures.

requirements.expected: Resize/scale after the first frame changes the actual GPUI window, crops to the current physical size, and records per-frame viewport provenance.

implementation.detail: The driver now tracks current_viewport, mutates it on Resize/Scale, normalizes each frame against it, and FrameArtifact/Conformance/verify_run use per-frame geometry. A headless resize regression test is added but cannot be executed under the withheld build lane.

requirements.gap: Run the new regression and a real production capture once the parent supplies a build lane; verify window.resize and scale-factor updates are reflected in GPUI pixels.

requirements.expected: Full-motion transitions require elapsed frames and changed pixels; reduced motion ignores dimension-only resize transitions and rejects same-size visual churn.

implementation.detail: Reduced-motion inspection now compares only same-dimension frames, while mixed-dimension full-motion transitions remain measurable through changed_pixels returning u64::MAX. No runtime verification was possible.

requirements.gap: Exercise resize plus reduced/full motion combinations in the build lane and inspect filmstrips/crops, not only manifests.

requirements.expected: Every route/state/overlay/keyboard requirement is rendered across wide/compact/narrow, 1x/2x, Ink/Glacier, and reduced/full motion.

implementation.detail: The contract describes the full matrix, but the production CLI accepts one state and one viewport per invocation and does not enumerate routes/themes/states/overlays. No current native matrix artifact was available.

requirements.gap: Add a matrix runner or scripted expansion and require actual PNG evidence for each cell.

requirements.expected: 2px periwinkle visible focus with 2px offset/5px halo, explicit labels/roles, deterministic focus order, and action state evidence.

implementation.detail: GPUI CE focus rings, labels, tab indexes, roles, and an explicit action tree are present. Focus pixels and native accessibility tree remain unobserved without a build lane.

requirements.gap: Verify focus crops at each viewport and increased text size, including collapsed panel controls and overlay restoration.

requirements.expected: All visual work stays in GPUI layout/elements; avoid canvas and generally avoid SVG unless the design asset is explicitly required.

implementation.detail: No canvas API was found in the inspected desktop source. The icon system is SVG-backed for all chrome, logos, kinds, facet, and faceted ground assets, so the user's no-SVG preference is not met for the current implementation.

requirements.gap: Replace routine chrome/kind geometry with GPUI primitives where practical; retain only explicitly approved identity artwork and prove raster output.

requirements.expected: Components remain legible and structurally valid at 80%-150% interface size, compact/comfortable/spacious density, narrow widths, collapsed panels, long labels, loading/error states, and all themes/motion modes.

implementation.detail: The token and layout models expose the stress dimensions, but render_root does not consume ResponsiveLayout and no native screenshot set exists to prove text wrapping/collapse behavior.

requirements.gap: Make each component independently capturable, then compose the shell only after component crops pass this stress matrix.

merge_order.name: Freeze the shared contract and extraction base
merge_order.operation: Do not cherry-pick dirty branch trees wholesale. Create reviewable commits from the units below; keep one CLI and one apps/desktop GUI crate.
merge_order.postcondition: Every later commit has a single owner and a bounded file list.

merge_order.name: Semantic primitive substrate
merge_order.operation: Land ActionRole/State/Metadata/Tree/Frames, parent/modal frame lifecycle, post-layout measure, and native-focus recording. Adapt Foundation::track_bounds to this seam.
merge_order.postcondition: One ActionTree and one measured ActionFrames snapshot can explain every interactive pixel.

merge_order.name: Stable action scopes and product focus
merge_order.operation: Add ActionScope, stable_focus_key, focus_entries, FocusTree origin/traversal/modal restoration; feed it from U1 rendered actions.
merge_order.postcondition: Focus traversal, modal trap, escape, and restore have one product authority and one native evidence bridge.

merge_order.name: Retargetable animation timeline
merge_order.operation: Land CaptureFrameClock, channels, versions, retargeting, reduced-motion snap, and UiRootEntity animation fields. Bind panel/disclosure/overlay/graph values to named channels.
merge_order.postcondition: No route uses an independent EffectTransition or raw duration without a named design Beat.

merge_order.name: Canonical responsive shell geometry
merge_order.operation: Keep ContentConstraints and ResponsiveLayout::resolve; add last_layout/observe_layout to the U3 root; thread one resolved layout through shell and routes; wrap controls with U1/U2 semantics.
merge_order.postcondition: A 640/1024/1280/1440 resize and 200% text scale have one geometry decision. Motion target widths derive from layout constraints.
reject: reader and graph local width enums as layout inputs
responsive EffectTransition 200ms as a second timing authority

merge_order.name: Stateless Facet foundation and component gallery
sources: nudox-components-v8 ui/foundation.rs, ui/surface.rs, ui/text.rs, component-gallery binary/harness
merge_order.operation: Land visual builders only after U1-U4; map gallery variants to real ActionFrames and shared viewport/layout/motion state. Keep GPUI div composition.
merge_order.postcondition: Gallery specimens stress the same primitives/routes and produce the same semantic schema as live surfaces.

merge_order.name: Package read model and live lanes
sources: package-surface-v8 model/snapshot.rs, runtime client/mapping/coordinator, local-service registry DTO adapters
merge_order.operation: Add PackageSurfaceState and package record retention; merge SurfaceCommand lanes and coverage mapping into the unified runtime contract.
merge_order.postcondition: Package page receives source-backed lane resources without DTO decoding or fabricated values.

merge_order.name: Reader model and root payload
sources: reader-surface-v8 model/reader.rs, CatalogState.reader, Root ReaderIndex mapping
merge_order.operation: Add ReaderIndex and coverage states; merge the Root DTO field and every SnapshotData clone/update path. Normalize width diagnostics to U4.
merge_order.postcondition: Document/source views resolve admitted rows and honest missing states at every shell width.

merge_order.name: Rich package and reader route projections
merge_order.operation: Land rich dossier and reader folios; add U4 layout, U1 measure/roles, U2 focus scopes, and explicit graph insertion points without replacing the route projection.
merge_order.postcondition: Package/reader content is real producer-backed content with collapsible panels, long-copy behavior, and measured controls.

merge_order.name: Bounded graph model, request lane, and GPUI surface
merge_order.operation: Merge Graph request/DTO/CoalesceKey/mapping and graph resource into U6/U7 runtime/snapshot; land bounded GraphProjection; rename graph_canvas to graph_surface; add package/reader hooks.
merge_order.postcondition: Graph is a route projection using ordinary GPUI elements, bounded work, one shell/layout, and a distinct graph request identity.

merge_order.name: Evidence harness union
sources: motion-focus-v8 artifact/crops/per-frame viewport/resize and stress steps
merge_order.operation: Merge one CLI and one CaptureSession. Each frame carries effective viewport/scale/theme/motion and a SemanticProbe from rendered ActionFrames; union WindowFocus, TextScale, resize/reversal, overlays, routes, and state cases.
merge_order.postcondition: Conformance rejects wrong physical dimensions, missing measured hit targets, focus/native disagreement, modal leakage, and uninspected crops.

merge_order.name: Generic vendor adapters and final visual audit
merge_order.operation: Land generic labels/focus/tab/disabled/toggled adapters only after app semantics are stable; then run the full reference capture matrix in a future build lane.
merge_order.postcondition: Vendor components remain behavior adapters, and native pixels/semantics are verified at 1280x720 plus stress sizes.
